data.name: Category_Uncategorized
data.value: Uncategorized

data.name: Error_PeriodToBeforeFrom
data.value: Parameter 'to' cannot be earlier than 'from'.

data.name: Import_EmptyFile
data.value: The file is empty.

data.name: Import_UnrecognizedFormat
data.value: This file does not look like a statement from the selected bank.

data.name: Import_NoRows
data.value: No transactions could be read from the file.

data.name: Import_FileTooLarge
data.value: The file is too large (limit: 10 MB).

data.name: Import_UnknownBank
data.value: Unknown bank — no parser available for it.

data.name: Import_UnknownBudget
data.value: The selected budget no longer exists.

data.name: Import_BudgetDisabled
data.value: This budget is switched off and does not accept new data.

data.name: Budget_NameRequired
data.value: Give the budget a name.

data.name: Budget_UnsupportedCurrency
data.value: That currency is not supported.

data.name: Transaction_DescriptionRequired
data.value: Give the transaction a description.

data.name: Transaction_DescriptionTooLong
data.value: The description is too long (limit: 500 characters).

data.name: Training_Busy
data.value: An import is running. Training would categorise half of it with the old model and half with the new one, so it has to wait.

data.name: Training_NoData
data.value: There is nothing to train on — no base file and no qualifying corrections.

data.name: Training_UnknownModel
data.value: That model version is no longer on disk.

data.name: Savings_AmountInvalid
data.value: The goal must be greater than zero — “saving 0” is not a goal, it is the absence of one.

data.name: Limit_AmountInvalid
data.value: The limit must be greater than zero.

data.name: Limit_WarningThresholdInvalid
data.value: The warning threshold must be between 1 and 100% of the limit.

data.name: Limit_CategoryInvalid
data.value: A spending limit cannot be set on this category — it does not exist or it is an income category.

data.name: Limit_HistoryLocked
data.value: Limits change from the current month on — closed months keep the limit that applied to them.

data.name: StandingOrder_NameRequired
data.value: Name the standing order — e.g. “Rent”.

data.name: StandingOrder_PatternInvalid
data.value: The title phrase needs at least 3 characters — a shorter one matches almost every transaction.

data.name: StandingOrder_RulesInvalid
data.value: A standing order needs between 1 and 20 matching rules.

data.name: StandingOrder_AmountInvalid
data.value: The amount must be greater than zero and the “from – to” range cannot be reversed.

data.name: StandingOrder_DueMonthInvalid
data.value: A yearly or quarterly standing order needs the month it is paid in.

data.name: EpisodicOrder_NameRequired
data.value: Name the order — e.g. “New laptop”.

data.name: EpisodicOrder_PlanInvalid
data.value: A planned order needs a category, an amount above zero and a due month.

data.name: EpisodicOrder_TransactionInvalid
data.value: This transaction cannot be used — it must be an expense from this budget and not belong to another one-off order.

data.name: EpisodicOrder_StateConflict
data.value: The order has changed — refresh the screen and try again.

data.name: Reservation_NameRequired
data.value: Give the reservation a name — an amount without one is not an envelope.

data.name: Reservation_AmountInvalid
data.value: The reservation amount must be greater than zero.

data.name: Reservation_SettlementInvalid
data.value: This transaction cannot settle the reservation. It has to be a withdrawal from savings in the same budget, not already used to settle another one.

data.name: Reservation_AlreadySettled
data.value: This reservation is already settled. Undo the settlement first if you picked the wrong transaction.

data.name: Request_Invalid
data.value: The request was invalid — usually a broken parameter in the address (a date or a filter). Clear the filters and try again.

data.name: Rule_PatternRequired
data.value: A rule must look at the description or the operation type. With neither, it would match every transaction.

data.name: Rule_PatternInvalid
data.value: The pattern is not a valid regular expression.

data.name: Rule_AmountRangeInvalid
data.value: The lower bound must be smaller than the upper one — with equal bounds the rule matches nothing.
